evidencePolicy: Universal all-app continuous delivery policy, platform registry/adapters, cross-platform conflict index, immediate per-change promotion, BG167/BG168/BG169 integration, full regressions and exact production evidence must all be green. Independent platform migrations may complete separately but hidden release islands are not allowed.
recoveryPolicy: Keep existing last-known-good delivery paths active while migrating adapters independently. Never batch unrelated changes or rebuild branches solely for non-overlapping main drift. A failing platform adapter blocks only itself and true dependents; unrelated green delivery continues.
